title: The World's Glaciers Are Disappearing Faster Than Ever
hook: Glacier melting just hit a record pace.
closing: Earth is basically shedding a mountain range of ice every single year now.
question: Seen a glacier shrink yourself?

segments.say: Glaciers used to lose far less ice a year -- now it's 390 billion tons, and still climbing.
That's already bigger than Greenland's whole ice sheet loses -- 390 billion tons from glaciers versus Greenland's share.
All that melted glacier ice has already pushed global sea levels up 18 millimeters since 2000.
